text:
dana: Hey folks — quick follow-up from today's all-hands reorg section. A couple of questions from my PM team about who to talk to about moving from senior IC -> engineering manager, and whether TL rotations are still planned for Q2?

sanjay: Good Q. TL rotations are still in the plan but timeline shifted slightly. We're aiming to start pilot rotations in mid-May (approx 6 weeks). :calendar:

maria: Can you clarify headcount delta per org? We lost the slide in the deck. Is it net +8 eng hires or something else?

sanjay: Net change is +8 engineering headcount company-wide, but it's redistributed: +5 infra/platform, +3 product/pp. A few heads are re-banded from contractor to full-time but that doesn't change net.

oliver: Are the TL rotation roles backfilled? Concerned about temporary coverage for infra owners.

sanjay: Yes — rotations are paired with coverage plans. We'll publish a rota doc next week with owners and temporary backups. Expect a 8-12 week rotation window per participant.

lucy: For IC->manager path, what's the official criteria? Is there a written rubric we can point folks to?

maria: HR was compiling the rubric. I think there's also a calibration session with Eng Leads + People Ops before we open applications.

dana: Could we get that rubric in the next sync? My teammates want clear promotion signals.

hr-bot: @channel New: internal promotion rubric draft uploaded -> https://intra.redwood/reports/ic-to-manager-rubric (draft). Please comment by EOD Thurs.

maria: Thanks hr-bot. Also, does the +8 commit require approvals from all team leads or just execs? Need to plan interviews.

sanjay: Exec approvals secured; hiring funnels will open centrally. Teams will get slots allocated and can run interviews. Hiring cadence: first ramp batch opens May 10.

oliver: Any changes to interview loop when hiring for TL rotations? Eg shorter loop or backfill priority?

sanjay: For rotation backfills we recommend a 2-interviewer quick loop (peer + manager) to move fast; for permanent TL hires, standard loop applies.

lucy: Will internal candidates for manager roles be prioritized? Some folks are hesitant to apply fearing they won't be considered first.

maria: Yes — internal candidates are prioritized if they meet the rubric. We encourage applications and manager referrals.

dana: One more — will we keep team org charts updated publicly? Last time it lagged.

sanjay: We'll push an updated org map on Monday and add automated weekly snapshots to the console so it's not stale.

lucy: Awesome. Thanks! :thumbsup:

maria: If folks want to chat 1:1 about career paths, drop a note and we'll book time this week.

dana: Thanks all — closing loop for my team. :white_check_mark:
